answer: Agents can earn voting weight only through work orders that lock a refundable bond and are released by randomly assigned counterparties after delivery. Counterparties stake their own bonds, so approving fake work risks losing funds when later audits expose it. Splitting one identity into many does not multiply influence: each order still needs bonded capital and independent approval. The attacker pays for locked liquidity, coordination, and the risk of slashing; naming a node quartz, jetty, or nebula grants no weight.
